domain: SCIENTIFIC INTELLIGENCE (themes, research records, institutions, researchers, resistance)
summary: Today the Science screen shows 13 "classified themes" (10 from D.SCI_THEMES + 3 from ITALY_SCIENCE.EXTRA_THEMES), a 36-row "RECENT RESEARCH" table, a 14-name "RESEARCHERS" panel, a 12-row "INSTITUTIONS · 12" panel, a GIRE resistance block, and a per-theme detail view (isTheme, markup 2157-2184). Only two of those blocks stand on real ingested data: the GIRE resistance block (portale.html 3244-3300 reads window.ITALY_INGEST.RESISTANCE directly, 34 cases, every field 34/34 populated) and 12 of the 36 research rows (which come from window.ITALY_REAL.SCIENCE, an older hand-curated fixture, not from IG). The other 24 research rows are procedurally generated in italy-demo-data.js:385-389 with seed() — fabricated year, institution, study type, descriptor, "why" prose and study location. The 12 institutions are a hardcoded name array (italy-demo-data.js:370) whose record counts are counted over those fabricated rows. The real backing is IG.THEMES (5), IG.SCIENCE (88), IG.RESEARCHERS (60) and IG.RESISTANCE (34); italy-app-model.js already exposes scienceRecords/researchers/resistance but three of its science field mappings are dead (measured 0/88 and 0/60) because it reads demo-era key names that the real schema does not have.
realSource: APP.collections.scienceRecords (88, from IG.SCIENCE) + APP.collections.researchers (60, from IG.RESEARCHERS) + APP.collections.resistance (34, from IG.RESISTANCE) + a NEW APP.collections.scienceThemes projected from IG.THEMES (5). Institutions must be DERIVED, and there are two distinct and non-interchangeable derivations: (a) IG.SCIENCE[].INSTITUTION — 6 distinct values, the FIRST AUTHOR's affiliation on each of the 88 records: University of Verona 27, University of Turin 25, University of Milan 16, Institute of Sciences of Food Production 15, INRAE 3, Instituto de Agricultura Sostenible 2 (the last two are French and Spanish, not Italian); (b) IG.THEMES[].INSTITUTIONS_TOP — 37 distinct institutions with a per-theme WORKS count (11-12 per theme). (a) counts records in this corpus; (b) counts works in the upstream OpenAlex theme query. They must never be summed or shown under one label. window.ITALY_SCIENCE stays as an explicitly-labelled interpretation layer, but only for the 5 theme keys that have a real counterpart.

risks: The screen gets visibly emptier and the numbers get visibly smaller: 13 themes -> 5, 12 institutions -> 6, 36 'records' -> 88 (this one grows), 14 researchers -> 60. Three of the five theme detail pages will have an empty publications list. Someone will read that as a regression. It is not; it is the first honest version of this screen.

The 88-record corpus is 7 authors deep. If the count ships without that caption next to it, it will be quoted as 'Sintonia monitors 88 Italian studies' and there is no way to walk that back later. This is the highest-consequence item in the whole domain.

Two of the six real institutions are not Italian (INRAE, France; Instituto de Agricultura Sostenible, Spain). Any header wording like 'Italian institutions' becomes false the moment the panel is repointed.

IG.SCIENCE has no theme key. The record<->theme join is inferred from CROP+ISSUE and it leaves 5 of 88 records (IT-SCI-001, 002, 086, 087, 088) belonging to no theme. Those records must stay reachable in the flat table, or 5 real records silently vanish from the product.

INSTITUTION on a record is the FIRST author's affiliation, and INSTITUTIONS_TOP on a theme is a works count from a different query. The two panels sit within 20 lines of each other in the markup (2082 and 2175) and mixing their denominators is the easiest mistake available here.

IG.RESEARCHERS.ROLE and FACT_REGION are 60/60 Portuguese analyst notes ('NÃO SEI — ...'). They already flow through the app model unfiltered. Any view that binds AM researcher role today ships that note to the user; the guard must land in the model, not in one view.

The theme<->opportunity link is deleted in three places (case detail 2628, archive detail 3340, theme detail 2176). If any of the three is missed, a fixture-only relationship keeps rendering while the other two disappear, which is worse than either state alone.

T.CROPS / T.ISSUES do not have entries for a single real token. Repointing the view without the token->label map first will put VINE, DURUM_WHEAT and FLAVESCENCE on an Italian screen in raw uppercase.

th0 falls back to sciDetailThemes[0]. Every existing link and bookmark to a demo theme id (8 of 10 ids disappear) will silently render a different theme's facts under the requested id unless STEP 13 lands with STEP 8.

winFor2() (line 3197) reads D.WINDOWS and turns it into 'WINDOW OPEN · N days remaining'. It belongs to the windows domain but is invoked from buildTheme, so it can be missed by both owners. Coordinate this one line explicitly.

ITALY_SCIENCE.B is authored interpretation, not a fixture, and the UI already labels it honestly. Deleting it wholesale would remove the one thing on the screen that connects science to business. Deleting only the 5 orphan keys is the right cut, and it is a judgement call worth confirming with the product owner.
openQuestions: ITALY_SCIENCE.B is Sintonia's own business interpretation, already labelled on screen as 'an interpretation layer over the science, not a scientific conclusion'. Does Rule 2 (a demo fixture may never supply a fact) apply to it? My reading: the rel/short/why/shows/notShows prose is interpretation, allowed, but ONLY over a theme that really exists upstream — so keep the 5 mapped keys, drop the 5 orphans. Confirm before deleting authored copy.

The three EXTRA_THEMES (herbicide resistance, weed management, biocontrol) declare works:null and 'not ingested' in their own text. Should they stay visible under a separate labelled heading (my recommendation, since they document a known gap), or be removed until data exists?

IG.THEMES.WORKS (135/70/71/27/17) counts works matching an OpenAlex QUERY. IG.SCIENCE holds 88 harvested records. These are two different universes and the theme detail page will show both at once (works 71, records 0 for OLIVE_BACTROCERA). What exact wording distinguishes them on screen?
Is there an upstream plan to add a THEME key to IG.SCIENCE? If yes, the CROP+ISSUE join in STEP 4 is temporary scaffolding and should be marked as such in a comment.
The 'BUSINESS RELEVANCE' column of the records table (SB.RECORD_REL, keyed by demo themeId) can only resolve for the two themes that have records. Keep the column with blanks, or drop the column?

Does any other domain already bind AM.collections.researchers[].role or .org? If so the Portuguese note may already be on screen somewhere I did not look, and the model-side guard becomes urgent rather than tidy.

window.ITALY_REAL.SCIENCE (12) and .RESEARCHERS (14) are an earlier hand-curated real fixture with fields IG does not have (kind, what, region, focus, note). Is it superseded by IG entirely, or is it a second real source that should be merged? I assumed superseded; it is the one assumption in this spec I could not settle from the data alone.
